service.label: Industrial digital twins
service.title: A plant you can walk through before it exists
service.lead: 3DNA Digital Twin is our technology for presenting industrial plants in interactive 3D: the complete layout, every piece of equipment, the process flow and the economic model in a single tool that runs in the browser.
items: The complete plant generated in 3D: silos, tanks, columns, pipes, platforms and buildings, explorable from any viewpoint.
Every process stream, electrical feeder, steam, water and air line appears as a selectable engineering layer, from source to destination.
Select any piece of equipment to see its function, its area and its connections to the rest of the plant.
A CAPEX and OPEX model connected to the plant, to test scenarios of capacity, prices and costs.

process.label: Process visualisation
process.title: From grain to product, step by step
process.lead: In the Canadian ethanol case study, the process runs through twelve areas, from wheat receiving to 99.5 % ethanol, wet distillers grain for the adjacent feedlot and the utilities that support them.

equipment.label: Equipment exploration
equipment.title: Every piece of equipment, with its function and connections
equipment.lead: Select a fermenter, a column or a tank and the digital twin highlights it, brings the camera closer and shows its role in the process, its specifications and the equipment it connects to.

finance.label: Investment and costs
finance.title: Investment scenarios in real time
finance.lead: The calculator links the facility to its economics in Canadian dollars: production, yield, wheat, ethanol and distillers-grain prices, natural gas, electricity, personnel and unit investment. Every change updates CAPEX, OPEX, EBITDA, margin, cost per litre and payback.
finance.note: The technical and financial values in the demonstration are illustrative. In a real project they are calibrated with the client's and its engineering firm's data.

audiences.label: Who it is for
audiences.title: One tool for every party in the project
items: Understand the plant, the process and the project's economics before committing the investment, and compare scenarios visually.
Present your machinery inside a complete plant, in context and with its connections, for trade fairs, offers and sales training.
Communicate the layout and the process to clients and financiers with an interactive model, clearer than drawings and static presentations.

showcase.label: Case study
showcase.title: Canadian Ethanol Production Facility
showcase.text: Explore a Canadian grain-based ethanol production facility through an interactive 3D environment combining industrial process visualization, equipment intelligence and financial modelling.
showcase.imageAlt: Presentation render of the 3D ethanol production facility on a dark background
showcase.disclosure: Inspired by publicly available information about Canadian ethanol manufacturing. The 3D layout and financial scenarios are illustrative. No affiliation with the reference facility is implied.
